name: firefox-mcp-connect
description: Unofficial, community-built with Claude (Claude Code + Cowork): lets Claude control your own Firefox. List and switch tabs, open pages, read them, take screenshots, click, type and scroll, with your existing sign-ins. Needs the free Claude MCP Connect Firefox add-on. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Anthropic or Mozilla.

connection_code.title: Connection code from Firefox
connection_code.description: Optional. Install the Claude MCP Connect add-on in Firefox, click its toolbar icon (look in the puzzle-piece Extensions menu if it's hidden), click 'Copy connection code', and paste it here. If you leave this empty, paste the code into the chat when Claude asks for it; Claude saves it for next time.

port.title: Port
port.description: Leave at 8765 unless another program uses it. It must match the Port in the Claude MCP Connect add-on's Options.
